e.title: ABCD（美国精算咨询与纪律委员会）：投诉调查流程与公开纪律记录
e.title_en: ABCD (US Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline): the complaints investigation process and public discipline records
e.title_hk: ABCD（美國精算諮詢與紀律委員會）：投訴調查流程與公開紀律記錄
e.summary: 美国精算职业的咨询与纪律机构：设投诉入口、调查流程与目标时限、标准指引，并公开「公开纪律」栏与行为守则、美国资格标准
e.summary_en: The US actuarial profession’s counseling and discipline body: it provides a complaints route, an investigation process with a target timeline and standards guidance, and publishes a "Public Discipline" section alongside the Code of Conduct and US Qualification Standards
e.summary_hk: 美國精算職業的諮詢與紀律機構：設投訴入口、調查流程與目標時限、標準指引，並公開「公開紀律」欄與行為守則、美國資格標準
e.body:
**ABCD（Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline，美国精算咨询与纪律委员会）** 是**美国精算职业的纪律与咨询机构**——**既接受对精算师的投诉并调查，也提供「咨询（counseling）」这一预防性渠道**。本条目补的是**「职业纪律与公开纪律记录」这一形态**：**实测池内「精算伦理/行为准则」形态为 0**（**池内有 [[compliance-officer]] 这类岗位条目、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 这类治理概念，但「职业纪律机构与其公开记录」此前没有**）。

⭐ **一个必须写明的实测细节**：**ABCD 的内容托管在 `actuary.org`（美国精算师协会 American Academy of Actuaries 的域名）上**——**`abcdboard.org` 实测返回的页面标题即「Actuarial Board Of Counseling And Discipline - Actuary.org」**；**故本词条引用的是 `actuary.org` 下的规范路径**。⚠️ **我最初依据相对链接猜测的 `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/` 实测 404**——**真实路径在 `actuary.org` 下**（**又一次「不要猜路径」**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Professionalism（职业操守）」页 `/professionalism/` 实测 70.1KB，标题「Professionalism - Actuary.org」**；⭐ **「Public Discipline（公开纪律）」页 `/professionalism/public-discipline/` 实测 56.4KB，标题「Public Discipline - Actuary.org」**；⭐ **「Complaints（投诉）」页 `/professionalism/actuarial-board-of-counseling-and-discipline/complaints/` 实测 60.5KB**；**「Code of Conduct（行为守则）」页 `/professionalism/code-of-conduct/` 实测 50.9KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的职业操守结构**：**Professionalism** 下含 **Understanding Professionalism**、**Code of Conduct**、**U.S. Qualification Standards**、**Discussion Papers**、⭐ **Public Discipline**、⭐ **Potentially Disruptive Events（潜在破坏性事件）**、**Actuarial Standards Board**、**Actuarial Board For Counseling And Discipline**；ABCD 分组下实测含 **about-abcd / abcd-responsibilities**、**standards-guidance（标准指引）**、**complaints**、⭐ **complaints/flow-chart-of-the-abcds-investigation-process-target-timeline（调查流程与目标时限流程图）**、**presentations**、**abcd-members**、**contact-the-abcd**；站点另有 **Newsroom**、**Calendar**、**Resources** 与 **`/publication/contingencies/`**（会刊 Contingencies，实测含 **「Up to Code」** 专栏）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「职业纪律」这一层**——**精算职业的约束不只来自考试与准则，还来自「被投诉 → 调查 → 处理」这条线**；**对准备入行或已在实习的学生，「哪些行为会被投诉、流程怎么走、什么会被公开」是可查的**（可与同轮 [[asb-us]] 的准则、[[cia-ica]] 的强制职业操守模块并读——**「定准则 / 纪律 / 教育」是职业自律的三条不同腿**）。**② ⭐ 「公开纪律（Public Discipline）」栏是本轮最值得注意的一处**——**纪律结果被公开**，**这与池内 [[fos-uk]] 的公开裁决库、[[eiopa-registers]] 的分销商处罚统计属同一类「把处理结果公开」的做法**，**但对象不同：那两条处理的是机构与消费者争议，这一条处理的是职业成员的执业行为**。**③ 「调查流程与目标时限流程图」值得单独注意**——**把「多久内该有下文」写进流程图**，**对研究程序正义与监管效率的学生是一个具体设计**（**注意：本次只核实该链接存在，未打开流程图**）。**④ 「潜在破坏性事件（Potentially Disruptive Events）」是一个少见议题**——**职业操守在极端情形（如机构危机、被迫签字）下的适用问题**，**对做职业伦理讨论的学生是可用的题目来源**。**⑤ 会刊《Contingencies》设有「Up to Code」专栏**——**把职业操守做成连续专栏**，**说明这是长期议题而非一次性宣导**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航与链接逐字实测的职业操守与 ABCD 分组结构、以及若干子页链接的存在**，**但未打开任何一条公开纪律记录、未打开任何投诉案例、未打开流程图、未打开行为守则或资格标准正文、未打开「Up to Code」专栏文章**，因此**不能转述任何纪律案件、处理结果、被处理人、行为守则条款或调查时限的具体数值**；**② ⭐ 本词条不主张「公开纪律」栏中现有多少条记录、也不主张其公开范围**——**本次仅核实该栏目存在（56.4KB）**；**③ 我猜测的 `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/` 路径实测 404**——**真实路径在 `actuary.org` 下，词条内已写明这一点**；**④ 「ABCD 与 AAA（美国精算师协会）、ASB 的关系」本次未核实**——**虽在同一域名下，本词条不据域名推断制度隶属**；**⑤ 「咨询（counseling）」职能的具体运作方式本次未核实**（**仅从机构名称与其导航条目推断，本词条已将其表述为「预防性渠道」并在此标注为推断**）；**⑥ Public Discipline 页 56.4KB 中多少是记录、多少是页面框架本次未区分**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** ABCD 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：`/professionalism/`（70.1KB）、`/professionalism/public-discipline/`（56.4KB）、`/professionalism/actuarial-board-of-counseling-and-discipline/complaints/`（60.5KB）、`/professionalism/code-of-conduct/`（50.9KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航；`abcdboard.org` 上的猜测路径实测 **404**（真实路径在 actuary.org）；**未打开任何纪律记录、投诉案例、流程图、守则正文或专栏文章**。
e.body_en:
**ABCD (the Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline)** is **the US actuarial profession’s discipline and counseling body** — **it both receives and investigates complaints against actuaries and offers "counseling" as a preventive channel**. This entry adds the **"professional discipline and its public record"** form: **the "actuarial ethics / code of conduct" form measured zero** (**the corpus has role entries such as [[compliance-officer]] and governance concepts such as [[three-lines-of-defense]], but no disciplinary body and its public record**).

⭐ **A measured detail that must be stated**: **ABCD’s content is hosted on `actuary.org`** (the domain of the American Academy of Actuaries) — **`abcdboard.org` measures a page titled "Actuarial Board Of Counseling And Discipline - Actuary.org"**; **so this entry cites canonical paths under `actuary.org`**. ⚠️ **The path I first guessed from a relative link, `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/`, measured 404** — **the real path sits under `actuary.org`** (**another "do not guess paths"**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Professionalism" page `/professionalism/` measures 70.1KB with the title "Professionalism - Actuary.org"**; ⭐ the **"Public Discipline" page measures 56.4KB with the title "Public Discipline - Actuary.org"**; ⭐ the **"Complaints" page measures 60.5KB**; the **"Code of Conduct" page measures 50.9KB**. **Navigation and links read verbatim reveal the professionalism structure**: under **Professionalism** — **Understanding Professionalism**, **Code of Conduct**, **U.S. Qualification Standards**, **Discussion Papers**, ⭐ **Public Discipline**, ⭐ **Potentially Disruptive Events**, **Actuarial Standards Board** and **Actuarial Board For Counseling And Discipline**; the ABCD grouping measurably includes **about-abcd / abcd-responsibilities**, **standards-guidance**, **complaints**, ⭐ **complaints/flow-chart-of-the-abcds-investigation-process-target-timeline**, **presentations**, **abcd-members** and **contact-the-abcd**; the site also has **Newsroom**, **Calendar**, **Resources** and **`/publication/contingencies/`** (the magazine Contingencies, measurably carrying an **"Up to Code"** column).

For RIAA: **① it adds the professional discipline layer** — **the actuarial profession is constrained not only by examinations and standards but by the track from complaint to investigation to outcome**; **for students preparing to enter the field or already interning, "what conduct draws a complaint, how the process runs, and what gets published" is checkable** (readable with the standards in [[asb-us]] and the mandatory professionalism module in [[cia-ica]] — **setting standards, disciplining, and teaching are three different legs of self-regulation**). **② ⭐ The "Public Discipline" section is the round’s most notable find** — **disciplinary outcomes are published**; **this belongs with [[fos-uk]]’s public decisions database and [[eiopa-registers]]’ distributor sanction statistics as "publishing the outcome"**, **but the subjects differ: those two handle firms and consumer disputes, this handles the professional conduct of individual members**. **③ The investigation flow chart with a target timeline deserves separate note** — **"how long before you hear something" is written into a flow chart**, **a concrete design for students studying procedural fairness and supervisory efficiency** (**note: only the link’s existence was verified, not the chart**). **④ "Potentially Disruptive Events" is an uncommon topic** — **how professional conduct standards apply in extreme situations such as an institutional crisis or pressure to sign**, **a usable source of essay questions for professional-ethics work**. **⑤ The magazine Contingencies runs an "Up to Code" column** — **professional conduct treated as a continuous column**, **indicating a long-term agenda rather than a one-off campaign**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the professionalism and ABCD groupings read verbatim from navigation and links, and the existence of several subpage links**, **but opened no public discipline record, no complaint case, no flow chart, no code of conduct or qualification standard text and no "Up to Code" article**, so **no disciplinary case, outcome, named individual, code clause or specific investigation deadline can be restated**; **② ⭐ this entry does not claim how many records the "Public Discipline" section contains, nor its scope of publication** — **only the section’s existence (56.4KB) was verified**; **③ the path I guessed on `abcdboard.org` measured 404** — **the real path is under `actuary.org`, as stated in the entry**; **④ the relationship between the ABCD, the AAA and the ASB was not verified** — **although they share a domain, this entry does not infer institutional affiliation from the domain**; **⑤ how the "counseling" function actually operates was not verified** (**inferred from the body’s name and its navigation items; the entry labels it a "preventive channel" and flags that as inference here**); **⑥ how much of the 56.4KB Public Discipline page is records versus page frame was not distinguished**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the ABCD provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: `/professionalism/` (70.1KB), `/professionalism/public-discipline/` (56.4KB), `/professionalism/actuarial-board-of-counseling-and-discipline/complaints/` (60.5KB) and `/professionalism/code-of-conduct/` (50.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with navigation read verbatim; the guessed path on `abcdboard.org` measured **404** (real path under actuary.org); **no discipline record, complaint case, flow chart, code text or column article was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**ABCD（Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline，美國精算諮詢與紀律委員會）** 是**美國精算職業的紀律與諮詢機構**——**既接受對精算師的投訴並調查，也提供「諮詢」這一預防性渠道**。本條目補的是**「職業紀律與公開紀律記錄」這一形態**：**實測池內「精算倫理／行為準則」形態為 0**（**池內有 [[compliance-officer]] 這類崗位條目、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 這類治理概念，但「職業紀律機構與其公開記錄」此前沒有**）。

⭐ **一個必須寫明的實測細節**：**ABCD 的內容託管在 `actuary.org` 上**——**`abcdboard.org` 實測返回的頁面標題即「Actuarial Board Of Counseling And Discipline - Actuary.org」**；**故本詞條引用的是 `actuary.org` 下的規範路徑**。⚠️ **我最初依據相對連結猜測的 `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/` 實測 404**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Professionalism」頁 70.1KB**；⭐ **「Public Discipline（公開紀律）」頁 56.4KB**；⭐ **「Complaints（投訴）」頁 60.5KB**；**「Code of Conduct」頁 50.9KB**。**導航與連結逐字實測**：**Professionalism** 下含 **Understanding Professionalism／Code of Conduct／U.S. Qualification Standards／Discussion Papers／⭐Public Discipline／⭐Potentially Disruptive Events／Actuarial Standards Board／Actuarial Board For Counseling And Discipline**；ABCD 分組下含 **about-abcd-responsibilities／standards-guidance／complaints／⭐complaints-flow-chart-of-the-abcds-investigation-process-target-timeline／presentations／abcd-members／contact-the-abcd**；站點另有 **Newsroom／Calendar／Resources** 與 **`/publication/contingencies/`**（會刊 Contingencies，實測含 **「Up to Code」** 專欄）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「職業紀律」這一層**——**精算職業的約束不只來自考試與準則，還來自「被投訴 → 調查 → 處理」這條線**（可與同輪 [[asb-us]] 的準則、[[cia-ica]] 的強制職業操守模組並讀——**「定準則／紀律／教育」是職業自律的三條不同腿**）。**② ⭐ 「公開紀律」欄是本輪最值得注意的一處**——**紀律結果被公開**；與 [[fos-uk]] 的公開裁決庫、[[eiopa-registers]] 的分銷商處罰統計屬同一類做法，**但對象不同：那兩條處理機構與消費者爭議，這一條處理職業成員的執業行為**。**③ 「調查流程與目標時限流程圖」值得單獨注意**——**把「多久內該有下文」寫進流程圖**（**注意：本次只核實該連結存在**）。**④ 「潛在破壞性事件」是少見議題**——**職業操守在極端情形下的適用問題**。**⑤ 會刊設「Up to Code」專欄**——**把職業操守做成連續專欄**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的分組結構、以及若干子頁連結的存在**，**但未打開任何一條公開紀律記錄、未打開任何投訴案例、未打開流程圖、未打開行為守則或資格標準正文、未打開專欄文章**，故**不能轉述任何紀律案件、處理結果、被處理人、守則條款或調查時限的具體數值**；**② ⭐ 本詞條不主張「公開紀律」欄現有多少條記錄、也不主張其公開範圍**——**本次僅核實該欄目存在（56.4KB）**；**③ 猜測路徑實測 404，真實路徑在 `actuary.org` 下**；**④ 「ABCD 與 AAA、ASB 的關係」本次未核實**——**雖在同一域名下，不據域名推斷制度隸屬**；**⑤ 「諮詢」職能的具體運作方式未核實**（**已標注為推斷**）；**⑥ 56.4KB 中多少是記錄、多少是頁面框架未區分**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** ABCD 提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航；**未打開任何紀律記錄、投訴案例、流程圖、守則正文或專欄文章**。
